topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I reckon the weather's turned as fickle as a child's mood, just when the sun promised a good day. I meant to send word ahead, but the seasons weigh heavy, and the chores delay a man's mind. The sheep wandered, and I had to leave the path to gather them, losing track of the time. The barn was in no state to entertain guests, with the floor wet and the hay strewn about. My wife, she had her hands full, trying to make sense of the little we have for a feast. I thank you for your understanding, knowing how you value the cheer of company. Let's hope the saints smile on us when we can try again, and the harvest leaves us with a bit more to share.
